page.overview:
Who is Jabra?

Jabra is an agent of CP0. He was previously an agent of CP9, being the third strongest of this agency.

He was one of the major antagonists during the Enies Lobby Arc.

Jabra is a dark-skinned man, with a , a pointed goatee, and long hair braided in a thick , that somewhat resembles a scorpion's tail. He also has a scar running diagonally down his left eye. When in his half-wolf state, Jabra has an unusually large tail and snout. He has the kanji for tattooed on the front of his shoulder.

During the events at Enies Lobby, he wore small, pointed sunglasses on his forehead, small hoop earrings, and a black tie over his bare chest. He wore a black , that was white down the middle and always open, but somehow always covered his tattoo when in human form. He also wore a red sash around his waist over black pants and shoes. He basically resembles a typical Chinese Kung Fu martial artist, commonly found in various pop culture and media.
